The lack of professionalism here is dangerous in a real estate transaction. I do not recommend using this company.

Unfortunately, my husband was not able to get off work to be there, so I was. I asked the gentleman if we needed to open the outlet lid? He said "its not necessary". I explained "we had been living in the house for 4-5yrs, the house sat for about 2yrs prior. Not sure what it looked like in there". The gentleman stated "no problem I will let you know". (MIND YOU WE ARE FIRST TIME CUSTOMERS, HE'S NEVER BEEN TO MY HOME OR SEEN MY TANK). He did not have to open the outlet lid. Fast forward to March 2024, my tank is FULL!. We again call Leto, same gentleman came out. This time my husband was able to be there. My husband asked again if outlet lid needed to be opened. "No sir not necessary". Great! Fast forward to 09/09/2024, my tank is full. I called Leto, spoke with the VERY nice lady that always answers the phones, but she wasn't so nice this time. When I mentioned it had only been 4mos and the gentleman never opened our outlet lid to check for a filter, she got very defensive and said "I will have the owner call you. what day would you like to schedule?" I said "No ma'am you don't understand, we cannot shower or anything, I would like to see if someone can come out today?" She replied" On no ma'am, we do not have any opening today or tomorrow. It would have to be Wednesday" (3 days without being able to use my home). I said "Ma'am I am a returning customer, if this can't be done TODAY then I will be calling another company". She replied "well everyone is booked out to the end of the week so you're not going to find anyone sooner". I said "I AM A RETURNING CUSTOMER, YOU GUYS SUCK IN CUSTOMER SERVICE SATISFACTORY" She hung up. I assumed I would maybe hear from the owner but never did.
BUT I got my tank cleaned out, filter was cleaned and pipes jetted, all for the same price ALL ON THE SAME DAY! I found myself a new HONEST COMPANY!
